persons.name: Jagannātha
persons.evidence: jagannāthaju sudṛṣṭi tava verasa ... jagannāthayātā nimittina coyā juro

relations.evidence: bāhārayā padmasiṅana ... jagannāthayātā nimittina coyā juro
śrī 3 jayajitāmitra, thākurasana, jagannāthaju sudṛṣṭi tava verasa, bāhārayā padmasiṅana ... coyā juro

date.as_written: samvat śara śata vasū nabhamāse, aśitapakṣe, saptamī para, śrīkṛṣṇāṣṭamī, kṛrttikanakṣetre, vyārghātayoge, kujavāsare

notes: The year is given as 'śara śata vasū' (805 NS). King Jayajitāmitra Malla ruled Bhaktapur from 1673 to 1696 CE. Jagannātha was favored by the king ('sudṛṣṭi tava verasa') and the text was copied for him.
